question: Is Supabase SOC 2 Type 2 compliant?
quote: Supabase is SOC 2 Type 2 compliant and regularly audited.

question: Is Supabase ISO 27001 certified?
quote: Supabase is ISO 27001 certified.

question: Which customers can obtain Supabase's SOC 2 Type 2 report?
quote: To access the SOC 2 Type 2 report, you must be a Enterprise or Team Plan Supabase customer.

question: What audit period does Supabase's SOC 2 report cover?
quote: runs from 1 March to 28 February of the next calendar year.

question: Does Supabase's SOC 2 cover HIPAA compliance?
quote: SOC 2 does not cover, nor is it a substitute for, compliance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).

question: Are Supabase's HIPAA controls supported out of the box in self-hosted Supabase?
quote: These controls are not supported out of the box in self-hosted Supabase.

question: What is the minimum plan needed to sign a BAA with Supabase?
quote: You will need to be at least on the [Team Plan](https://supabase.com/pricing) to sign a BAA with us.

question: Which project settings are required for a HIPAA (High Compliance) project?
answer: Point in Time Recovery, SSL enforcement, network restrictions and Postgres connection logging enabled
quote: - Enabling [Point in Time Recovery](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/backups#point-in-time-recovery). - Turning on [SSL Enforcement](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/ssl-enforcement).

question: Is Postgres connection logging (log_connections) on by default for new Supabase projects?
quote: Supabase sets Postgres `log_connections` to off by default for new projects.

question: How often is Supabase audited for SOC 2 and HIPAA?
answer: Annually, with HIPAA controls audited in the same period as SOC 2
quote: Supabase undergoes annual audits. The HIPAA controls are audited during the same audit period as the SOC 2 controls.

question: Which TLS versions do Supabase project HTTP APIs accept?
quote: accept only HTTPS connections using TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3.

question: Is SSL enforced by default on direct Postgres connections?
answer: No (it can be turned on per project)
quote: Supabase projects support connecting to the Postgres DB without SSL enforced to maximize client compatibility.

question: Which AWS technology does Supabase PrivateLink use?
quote: between your AWS VPC and your Supabase database using AWS VPC Lattice.

question: Does PrivateLink cover Supabase API, Storage, Auth or Realtime traffic?
answer: No, only direct database and pooler connections
quote: It does not support other Supabase services like API, Storage, Auth, or Realtime.

question: How does Supabase protect against DDoS and brute-force attacks?
answer: Cloudflare at the edge, and fail2ban at the infrastructure layer
quote: Supabase protects against Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks at the edge via Cloudflare. At the infrastructure layer, fail2ban blocks IP addresses

question: How many days of daily backups can a Pro Plan project access?
quote: Pro Plan projects can access the last 7 days of daily backups.

question: How many days of daily backups can a Team Plan project access?
quote: Team Plan projects can access the last 14 days of daily backups

question: How many days of daily backups can an Enterprise Plan project access?
quote: Enterprise Plan projects can access up to 30 days of daily backups.

question: Are Free Plan projects included in Supabase's automatic daily backups?
quote: We automatically back up all Pro, Team, and Enterprise Plan projects on a daily basis.

question: What is the worst-case recovery point objective with PITR?
quote: Overall, in the worst case scenario, PITR achieves a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of two minutes.

question: How often are WAL files backed up by default under PITR?
answer: Every two minutes (sooner above a file size threshold)
quote: By default, we back up WAL files at two-minute intervals.

Do Supabase database backups include objects stored via the Storage API?

question: Are daily backups still taken once PITR is enabled?
quote: If you enable PITR, we will no longer take Daily Backups.

question: Which non-EU locations can the "Europe" general region deploy to?
quote: the "Europe" general region includes London and Zurich, which are not EU member states.

question: What is the default disk type and its baseline performance?
answer: gp3, with 125 MB/s throughput and 3,000 IOPS

question: Can projects on different plans share one Supabase organization?
